title: Grounded QA Ground Truth Dataset
description: Evaluation ground truth for a retrieval-grounded QA agent operating over chunked PDF content. Each item pairs a question with its expected answer, the safety classification of the question's topic, and the document sources the answer must be grounded in.

dataset_version.description: Semantic version of this ground truth dataset, e.g. 1.0.0.

description.description: Human-readable description of the dataset and its scope.

defaults.description: Default evaluation settings applied to every item unless the item overrides them.

id.description: Stable unique identifier for this question.

question.description: The natural-language question posed to the agent.

expected_answer.description: Reference answer evaluated with text-similarity / fuzzy comparison.

safety_level.description: Safety classification of the question's topic. Evaluated as an exact (direct) match.

traceability.description: Document source(s) the answer must be grounded in. Each source is evaluated as a direct match. A correct answer must cite at least the required sources.

answer_match.description: Per-item override of the fuzzy answer-matching configuration.

tags.description: Optional labels for slicing metrics (e.g. topic, difficulty).

text.description: Canonical reference answer text. Compared to the agent output via fuzzy / semantic similarity.

acceptable_variants.description: Alternative phrasings that are also fully correct. The agent's answer is scored against the best-matching variant.

must_include.description: Key facts/terms that must appear (fuzzily) in a correct answer regardless of phrasing. Useful as a hard gate alongside the similarity score.

must_not_include.description: Phrases or claims that, if present, mark the answer incorrect (e.g. hallucinated or unsafe content).

safetyLevel.description: Safety classification of the question topic, from least to most sensitive.

source.description: A single grounding source. All listed fields are compared as direct (exact) matches.

document_name.description: Display name / file name of the source document, e.g. handbook.pdf.

document_id.description: Stable document identifier used in the vector store / ingestion pipeline.

page.description: 1-based page number in the source PDF.

section_heading.description: Section heading the supporting chunk belongs to.

chunk_id.description: Optional ID of the specific chunk in the vector store, if available.

required.description: Whether citing this source is mandatory for full traceability credit. Defaults to true.

answerMatchConfig.description: Configuration for the fuzzy answer comparison.

method.description: Similarity method to use when scoring the answer.

threshold.description: Minimum normalized similarity (0-1) required to count the answer as correct.
